title: Toolchain smoke build rootfs identity

mechanism: A language toolchain is not proven by path lookup; it must compile or execute inside the selected rootfs with the expected runtime identity.
hypothesis: Python should report rootfs-owned executable/prefix/sysconfig data, C/C++ should compile and run a tiny binary, and Rust should compile and run a tiny binary in production mode.
minimal_fixture: A temporary directory under the private TMPDIR, one tiny C program, one tiny Rust program, and Python sysconfig introspection.
predicted_behavior: Production mode should successfully execute Python, compile C with a rootfs compiler, and compile Rust with the rootfs Rust toolchain.
